answer: Per-epoch proof-of-work is a concrete Sybil defense: each submission must carry a fresh random challenge that is costly to solve but cheap to verify, and difficulty scales with how many identities claim the epoch. An attacker renting a thousand wallets cannot split that cost, because every identity owes its own full compute bill, so the marginal price of the N-th fake identity never falls while its reward is diluted. The ledger is a mirror of real costs rather than intent, each miner is a lantern lighting only paid work, and subsidy, like a river, flows to whoever pays for the channel bed.
